_comment: Plugin msgid (English source, exactly as in the PHP/JS __() call) -> a catalogue key whose meaning is IDENTICAL. Keys `tackquote.*` come from the TackQuote shared widget catalogue vendored in widget/ (do not hand-translate those: fix the catalogue in tack, packages/widget/locales, and re-vendor). Keys `woo.*` (1.11.0) come from local/, the plugin's own catalogue for storefront text the shared catalogue has no identical entry for; local/en.json must read exactly as the msgid. `placeholders` maps each {name} in the catalogue text to the printf placeholder the plugin msgid uses. `storefront` says which source files shoppers see: tests/i18n-test.php fails when a msgid in them is neither mapped (and translated in every bundled language) nor listed in storefront.notStorefront with the reason.
